title: Lifting a single-degree map on one clopen rank stratum
statement: Let i: Z → Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], and put A = i_*O_Z with module direct image g_* [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category, def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. Let r: Z → ℕ be locally constant, with rank strata U_q [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex]. For arbitrary module sheaves E_q on U_q, let T^m = j_{m,*}E_m for nonnegative m and T^m = 0 for negative m. Choose D(A) [def-pc-derived-category]. Fix K in D(A) and n in ℤ. Assume only that H^m(K) is isomorphic as an A-module to g_*T^m for every m different from n. For every A-module map a: g_*T^n → H^n(K), there exists f: (g_*T^n)[-n] → K whose map on degree-n homology equals a under the canonical identification H^n((g_*T^n)[-n]) = g_*T^n. No finite-image assumption on r, and no specified H^n(K) or isomorphism assumption on a, are required.

proof.text: Use the repaired homology presentation to obtain the concentrated retract L and the homology projector fixing every map from g_*T^n.

Vanishing in all other degrees gives L.IsGE n and L.IsLE n. Apply the Mathlib concentrated-single theorem. Naturality of the canonical singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso lifts a≫H^n(π) to a map f into L. Composing f with ι induces a by the fixed-map identity.

theorem clopenRankStrata_homology_lift
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i)))]
    (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ)
    (E : ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r n).toScheme.Modules)
    (T : ℤ → Z.Modules)
    (hT : ∀ n : ℤ, T n = if 0 ≤ n then
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (Scheme.Modules.exteriorRankOpen r n.toNat).ι).obj
        (E n.toNat) else 0)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))))
    (n : ℤ)
    (hother : ∀ m : ℤ, m ≠ n → Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) m).obj K ≅
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj (T m)))
    (a : (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj (T n) ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) n).obj K) :
    ∃ f : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) n).obj
          ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj (T n)) ⟶ K,
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) n).inv.app
          ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj (T n)) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) n).map f = a
